question: Related Questions Q. I am performing duty in Police dept. I keep beard but wear full pant shit. Occasionally, I become imam in nearby masjid wearing full shirt due to non availability of any alim during namaz time. Is it correct? 2011 views Q. Salah procedure during travel 3916 views Q. Dear Mufti Saheb Assalam-u-alaikkum, 1a- We moved in to a new house, we and some visitors who came to our house prayed our farz etc salah in the wrong direction thinking that was the direction of the Qibla then someone told us that the Qibla is in another direction so do we have to do Qaza of the salah that was prayed in the wrong direction? 1b-If we have to make Qaza of the salah then do we have to tell the visitors aswell to repeat there salah? 2631 views Q. What should be read in the second Rakah of Taraweeh while sitting? 5354 views Q. I work in Saudi Arabia and go back home after every one year. I belong to Nainital district of U.P. (Now Uttarakhand) which is very near to Bareilly and the Barelwi Maslak is rampant in that area. "Mazar parasti" and Urs, etc., are the foremost part of their Islam and Aqeeda. In my village there are only two mosques and the Imams leading the prayers are staunch Barelwi. I had a discussion with one of these Imams of our moque, he has the belief that to ask for help (Mannat) with the dead (Mazar) is as good as praying God. Since then, I stopped praying with him. I offer all my five prayers in my home during my vacation of one month or so. Secondly, my wife is very punctual in prayers and other Shariah matters. She also joins my prayers which I lead in my house. Please enlighten me on;(1)if, under the circumstances explained above, my prayers in my home are correct, (2) prayers led by me and joined by my wife are correct. or I should go the mosque and pray behing the same Imam as explained above. I shall highly appreciate your immediate reply on the above e-mail address. Best regards 2929 views Q. Witar 5951 views Q. Standing Alone In Row 3005 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 29053 Country: India Title: Is it permitted to offer salaat by closing eyes.... as by opening eyes i often lose my concentration... reply must Question: asalamualaikum... is it permitted to offer salaat by closing eyes.... as by opening eyes i often lose my concentration... reply must Answer ID: 29053 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 141/141/M=1432) It is makrooh to offer salah with eyes closed. But if the attention is diverted by opening eyes and khushu’ is gained only by closing eyes, then it is allowed to keep eyes closed during salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
